visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with brown hair wearing a black cap backwards and a white t-shirt emerges from behind a frosted glass door, smiling widely. He gestures towards the camera. The setting is a brightly lit indoor space with white walls and a light wood counter. (2) The man stands centrally behind the counter. A visual overlay of a female cheerleader in a blue and white sports uniform appears in the foreground, posing with a hand gesture. Background objects include a sloth mascot and framed illustrations on the wall. (3) The scene transitions as the man throws his arms wide and points upward. A graphic overlay showing a detailed floor map of a baseball stadium appears on the screen, indicating specific seating areas and booth locations. (4) The man continues his energetic presentation, pointing his finger and smiling. A white and brown circular logo for "NAP TEA" featuring a sleeping sloth icon is superimposed on his chest area, accompanied by colorful confetti graphics. (5) New overlays appear: a circular orange logo for fried sweet potato balls, followed by a product shot of a cup of milk tea and a bowl of golden-brown sweet potato balls. The man gestures enthusiastically with both hands open. (6) A final overlay shows a YouTube channel interface with the names "Peter & Susan". The man waves goodbye with his right hand and walks out of the frame towards the left, ending the video.
